artifacts.purpose: Explicit protected dependencies and completed retirement selections
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: tools/storage_retention.py
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the registry from the private companion main history

retention_rule.rule: Keep the current registry; a completed job does not authorize deleting its protected outputs.

artifacts.purpose: Purchase criteria, quotes, decisions and transaction state
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Current or completed purchase case
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the private companion main history

retention_rule.rule: Keep structured cases and their unique referenced evidence, including completed purchases.

artifacts.purpose: Processed-message and follow-up state
artifacts.consumer_or_final_deliverable: Deduplication and pending follow-up
artifacts.rebuild_or_restore: Restore the complete state before resuming polling

retention_rule.rule: Keep current state and unresolved follow-up; do not discard to reset a job.
